{{Quote|Amazing how fast they can change things when they want to. Shame they couldn't have managed that speed and efficiency during the Republic.|Imperial Commando Darman commenting on the changes to the old CSF building|<ref name="501st" />}}
A '''Coruscant Security Force Divisional Headquarters''' served as a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] division base of operations for the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] in a sector of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="501st" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the newly formed [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] took possession of the building though it was still known as a CSF divisional headquarters. The building housed the ISB's information technology center. CSF [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jaller Obrim]] and his [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]] were headquartered there after being transferred to the ISB.<ref name="501st" />

Later, [[Clone commando/Legends|Imperial Commandos]] [[Niner Skirata|Niner]] and [[Darman Skirata|Darman]] came to turn over a disk with intelligence information to the ISB. Obrim, after finding the disk contained vital information on [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and rebel groups such as [[Whiplash]], palmed the disk and gave it back to Niner so that the information could be given to [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Kal Skirata]] and used to help those very groups. Out loud, Obrim lamented that the disk contained no information and logged a blank disk as evidence instead.<ref name="501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant Security Force Divisional Headquarters appeared in the novel ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2009]].<ref name="501st" />
